newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan's Crown Prince postpones Israel visit.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's Crown Prince postpones Israel visit.

text.p: Crown Prince Hassan of Jordan has postponed a visit to Israel next month because he is too busy, a palace official said on Tuesday.
He denied an Israeli press report that the trip had been put off because Jordan feared being seen as the only Arab country in close contact with the Jewish state.
"It's absolute nonsense. It's just overburdened schedules," the spokesman said. He said the visit was expected to go ahead later this year, but no new schedule had been fixed.
The trip would be just the second public visit by Prince Hassan to Israel, after he attended last year's funeral in Jerusalem of slain Israeli Prime Minister Yitzhak Rabin, the spokesman said.

Israel's Yedioth Ahronoth newspaper said on Tuesday Prince Hassan had postponed the visit, scheduled for October 6, because Jordan did not want to be seen to be too close to Israel at a time when Middle East peace talks had hit a stalemate.

Rabin signed a peace treaty in 1994 with Jordan, which of all of Israel's Arab peace partners has maintained the closest relations with the right-wing government of Benjamin Netanyahu since his election in May.
